summary: The blueprint broadly covers human pancreas but needs targeted coverage additions and marker/axis cleanup before it is publishable as-is.

issues.description: Whole-pancreas coverage is missing mesothelial/serosal capsule cells and adipocyte/lipid-rich stromal cells, which are plausible constituents of human pancreas tissue when age is unspecified and celltype is null.
issues.suggested_fix: Add modules and axes for mesothelial cells, for example MSLN, WT1, UPK3B, CALB2, KRT8, KRT18, PDPN, and adipocytes/lipid stromal cells, for example ADIPOQ, PLIN1, FABP4, LPL, CIDEA, LEP, CFD, PPARG.

issues.description: A distinct enterochromaffin-like endocrine cell axis is not a standard expected population for healthy human pancreas and currently presents serotonergic/gut-like biology as a core pancreatic endocrine cell type.
issues.suggested_fix: Delete this module and axis unless recast as a clearly scoped rare serotonergic endocrine state; prefer using the freed dimension for missing whole-tissue coverage or stronger immune/stromal resolution.

issues.description: The lymphatic axis is gated by a blood vascular endothelial module, which can suppress bona fide lymphatic endothelial cells, and the lymphatic marker set includes TFF3, an epithelial/secretory gene rather than a lymphatic endothelial marker.
issues.suggested_fix: Use a pan-endothelial gate or broaden the gate with pan-endothelial genes such as PECAM1, CDH5, CLDN5, ESAM, RAMP2; keep blood-vessel markers separate if needed. Replace TFF3 with a lymphatic endothelial marker such as TBX1, FOXC2, CCL21, or another accepted human lymphatic marker.

issues.description: SLC26A3 is more characteristic of intestinal/colonic chloride-bicarbonate exchange than pancreatic duct identity, while pancreatic duct bicarbonate biology is better represented by CFTR, SLC4A4, and SLC26A6.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace SLC26A3 with SLC26A6 or another accepted pancreatic ductal marker.

issues.description: The current t_cell_nk_cell and b_cell_plasma_cell modules merge biologically distinct immune populations, leaving expected whole-pancreas immune structure underresolved.
issues.suggested_fix: Split T vs NK with CD3D/CD3E/TRAC/IL7R/CCR7 versus NKG7/GNLY/KLRD1/PRF1/GZMB, and split B vs plasma with MS4A1/CD79A/CD79B/BANK1 versus MZB1/JCHAIN/SDC1/IGHG1/IGKC if adding dimensions.

out_of_scope: The developmental/progenitor axes are not automatically wrong because age is unspecified, but they should not dominate the design unless a future scenario explicitly requests fetal/developmental ordering.
